description:
Recorded road crashes by suburb and by council area per calendar year: fatal, serious-injury, other-injury and non-injury crashes, plus people killed and seriously injured, for every state and territory except the Northern Territory.

Coverage: NSW, Victoria, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania and the ACT: 2016-2025 (Queensland to 2024); Western Australia 2021-2025. About 15,000 suburbs and 520 council areas. No Northern Territory data. Current to 2026-11-07. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/road-crashes`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: casualty_crashes, fatal_crashes, serious_injury_crashes, other_injury_crashes, non_injury_crashes, people_killed, people_seriously_injured. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: lga_transport_road_crashes
